title: James Blunt tops the UK album chart for the first time in 19 years
summary: Airplane Mode beat Royal Blood to number one, and the singer had promised to change his name if it did.
body:
James Blunt has gone to number one on the UK's Official Albums Chart with Airplane Mode, his first chart-topping album since All the Lost Souls in 2007.

The result was announced on Friday 13 November. It is his third UK number one album, after Back to Bedlam and All the Lost Souls.

Royal Blood's run ends

Blunt finished ahead of the rock duo Royal Blood, whose album Dead Company entered at number two. Their previous four albums had all reached number one.

Before the chart was announced, Blunt joked that he would legally change his name to "Ryan Air" if the album reached the top. The Official Charts Company says it expects him to keep his word.

Sources: Official Charts Company, Billboard.
